simulated_reviews.headline: Great coverage
simulated_reviews.review_text: Medium buildable coverage hides blemishes effortlessly while feeling lightweight on the skin.
simulated_reviews.explanation: Praises natural buildable coverage and lightweight texture on skin.

simulated_reviews.headline: Natural matte finish
simulated_reviews.review_text: Gives a gorgeous natural matte finish that controls shine throughout the day.
simulated_reviews.explanation: Commends shine control and matte finish without looking flat.

simulated_reviews.headline: Impressive wear time
simulated_reviews.review_text: Lasts a full 8-hour workday without settling into fine lines or fading.
simulated_reviews.explanation: Highlights durable 8-hour longevity and resistance to creasing.

simulated_reviews.headline: Superb value
simulated_reviews.review_text: Incredible quality for the drugstore price, performs just like luxury foundations.
simulated_reviews.explanation: Praises exceptional value for money comparable to prestige brands.

simulated_reviews.headline: Photographs well
simulated_reviews.review_text: Smooth application with a satin-matte blur effect that photographs beautifully.
simulated_reviews.explanation: Approves of smooth application and flattering camera appearance.

simulated_reviews.headline: Average texture
simulated_reviews.review_text: The texture is somewhat thin and watery upon pouring, but blends out okay once applied with a sponge.
simulated_reviews.explanation: Mixed sentiment regarding thin consistency but acceptable sponge blending.

simulated_reviews.headline: Okay shade match
simulated_reviews.review_text: The shade runs slightly darker than the swatch, but workable when blended with a moist sponge.
simulated_reviews.explanation: Notes slight shade discrepancy but manageable with blending technique.

simulated_reviews.headline: Messy packaging without pump
simulated_reviews.review_text: Bottle has no pump dispenser, making it messy to pour and easy to waste product.
simulated_reviews.explanation: Criticizes lack of pump dispenser resulting in product spillage.

simulated_reviews.headline: Oxidized and patchy
simulated_reviews.review_text: Formula oxidized noticeably orange after two hours and clung to dry flaky patches.
simulated_reviews.explanation: Reports severe oxidation darkening and poor adherence to dry skin zones.

simulated_reviews.headline: Caused breakouts
simulated_reviews.review_text: Felt heavy and clogged my pores, causing breakouts after three days of wear.
simulated_reviews.explanation: Reports pore congestion and skin irritation after repeated application.
